blocks.content: Applications must generally be filed within SIX MONTHS of the cause of action, extendable by another 60 days.
Applications must generally be filed within SIX MONTHS of the cause of action, extendable by another 60 days.

items: Exams frequently ask for the primary limitation period: remember it is SIX MONTHS.
Note the maximum extension period allowed is 60 DAYS (not 1 or 2 months).
The time limit calculation always triggers from the date of 'cause of action'.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The general time frame for filing an application is within six months.
The limitation period strictly begins from the date of the cause of action.
An extension of up to 60 additional days may be allowed beyond the initial six-month period.
